title: KeyTap
tagline: Enabling access control through a zero trust protocol by incorporating multi-level based on attribute verification
description:
This project enables users to have permissions to advanced access control efforts through attributes and takes out existing binary processes that are usually in the manner of being strictly token gated or whitelisted. This allows for multi-level attribute level attribution and enables increased community involvement rather than have scarcity dependency.  

KeyTap can be viewed within the DataPlace, specifically through the 'Publish Page' under access section. 


Presentation can be found here: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1kTz2KqrHhp3b1G0klN_D7lINFMmL93Hh9rFSwVYCurA/edit?pli=1#slide=id.g1847071f12c_0_23
how_its_made: This project uses attribute based smart contracts for access control using soulbound NFT's under zero knowledge using EY Starlight. This enables fine grained access controls for data on any blockchain network including Polygon, Skale, Optimism, all more. Using PUSH chat helped an easy messaging between all the network participants. The subgraph helped make queries to indexed data for both access control and the nft martketplace. We are impressed by all the lego blocks that have made our project viable and fun to build
